crossRefs.note: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies:
Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat…
But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s dainties, nor with the wine which he…
“So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

translations.web: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.
translations.bsb: Do not crave his delicacies, for that food is deceptive.
translations.kjv: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
translations.asv: Be not desirous of his dainties; Seeing they are deceitful food.
